result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, with one minor visual inconsistency found in the favorite/heart icon styling on the promoted cards.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon background is white/opaque on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card but appears as a dark semi-transparent circle on the pizza card below it, creating inconsistent styling between similar card components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background style (color, opacity) across all restaurant/promo cards for visual consistency.
